strings.name: Javier Milei
strings.summary: Milei moved from economic research and television commentary into Congress and won the presidency in 2023. His fiscal cuts and deregulation sought stabilization while straining incomes, consumption and services. His coalition gained in the 2025 legislative election. A Libra-token promotion prompted investigation; in October 2026 a judge ended the criminal probe into him and his sister.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His radical reform platform and fiscal retrenchment brought international attention to Argentina’s changing state role.
